The gate classifies every module symbol signature change as MAJOR and (2) is a narrowed type under the snapshot contract, so this candidate is declared major; the cumulative delta since 0.0.0 was already MAJOR. Zero removals, no root growth, no runtime behaviour or CSS change; CEM, llms.txt, catalog and framework wrappers regenerate byte-identical. Nothing is published yet (0.0.0, private).
